name: vue-draggable-monorepo
description: Monorepo for a drop-in, vuedraggable-compatible draggable component for Vue 3 and its Nuxt module.
author: Nhữ Duy Thìn

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify && pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter @vue-draggable/playground run build && pnpm --filter @vue-draggable/nuxt run verify:nuxt
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @vue-draggable/core run verify:package && pnpm --filter @vue-draggable/core run verify:dist && node scripts/size.mjs --max-gzip 5120
